name: Unfinished Gordok Business
label: Quest
description: Unfinished Gordok Business: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now you da king, so maybe you get prized Gordok artifact back from creepy elf who calls himself Prince! Da king before you failed, just like all da other kings since Tortheldrin - da creepy elf - stole it from old timey Gordok king!

Artifact is called da Gauntlet of Gordok Might. Old timey stories say only da one true king da Gordok can get it back. Old timey story also say creepy elf is still around here - you find it and it will become mighty gauntlet you wear forever! Yar, I show you!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hah, you no find it, do you boss? Maybe old timey story a bad story... Hard to believe that creepy elf can steal from Gordok king!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wow... You ARE da true ruler! I never think I see this gauntlet in my life! It look like it got no mojo left anymore... Maybe that creepy elf try and ruin gauntlet. Well, I say HAR HAR to him!

Look - this mark on da gauntlet an old old OLD timey magic mark, older than da Gordok they say. Well, as Captain of da Gordok, we all learn one thing over and over - how to make mark come to life and give power back to gauntlet!
I do it for you, ruler! Here, take da gauntlet and rule FOREVER!
